name: Valley Bridge
facts: Valley Bridge, erected in 1865, stretches gracefully over Ramsdale, showcasing Victorian engineering prowess that still captivates drivers today.
Originally constructed as Lendal Bridge in York, this structure met a dramatic collapse before being salvaged and reassembled in Scarborough, a testament to 19th-century ingenuity.
The bridge’s relocation from York to Scarborough highlights a rare 19th-century practice of repurposing entire bridges, a feat rarely seen in modern infrastructure projects.
